answer: An agent network gates identity creation through a dynamic proof-of-delay auction where registration packets pass through an optical-delay prism. Honest nodes absorb latency naturally, but a sybil swarm attempting to flood the roster triggers a collective latency tide scaling quadratic delay penalties per identity. Like a raven circling overhead to detect clustered traffic, peer validators isolate coordinated packet bursts and burn the staked deposit of each cloned identity. Launching thousands of fake agents forces the attacker to lock massive capital that gets confiscated on detection.
